app.title: DevLog
app.subtitle: Time spent building, one repository at a time.
language.label: Language
language.name: English
report.empty: No tracked time in this period. Start a task with dl start.
report.chart_unavailable: The chart could not load. Recorded hours are available in the table below.
cli.description: Track time spent working in Git repositories.
cli.start_help: Start or resume this repository's task.
cli.commit_help: Stage all changes, commit, finish the task, and push.
cli.publish_help: Run this repository's release script without changing the timer.
cli.record_help: Record an existing commit after a tracking failure; do not commit or push again.
error.no_task: This repository has no unfinished task. Run dl start first.
error.task_conflict: The task changed during the operation. No task was completed.
error.unavailable: The operation could not be completed. Check the DevLog service and its log.
error.bad_report: Use valid dates, an existing repository, and a range of at most 366 days.
error.recovery: Local commit {commit_sha} exists, but recording its task was not confirmed. Once the service is available, run dl commit --record {commit_sha}. Do not create another commit to retry tracking.
error.publish_missing: No release script found. Expected new_release.sh, scripts/new_release.sh, or scripts/new-release.sh.
error.not_repository: Run dl inside a Git repository.
error.invalid_remote: Configure a GitHub origin remote for this repository.
error.commit_message: Provide a nonempty commit message of at most 16384 UTF-8 bytes.
error.commit_arguments: Provide either a commit message or --record SHA.
error.request_timeout: DevLog request timed out; its outcome may be unknown. No automatic retry was made.
error.transport_failed: DevLog ZMQ transport failed. Check the configured endpoint and service.
error.invalid_response: The service returned an invalid response.
